$schema_note: Podcast Production Engine (Skill 58) CAPABILITY MANIFEST — the machine-readable contract the Command Center dispatch resolver reads BEFORE assigning a podcast task. A podcast task must never be dispatched to a box whose processor is not activated (the phantom-agent root cause: dispatch minted 'audio-podcast-editor' from thin air and the heartbeat woke a tool-less session). When this manifest is absent, OR activation is not complete, the Command Center MUST refuse the dispatch loudly and tell the operator to run SOP-PODCAST-07 (ACTIVATION RESCUE). This file names env labels and file paths only — never a secret value.

activation.rescue_sop_message: No podcast processor activated on this box — run SOP-PODCAST-07 (ACTIVATION RESCUE): install-podcast-department.sh then register-podcast-hook.sh, then confirm with guard-activation-health.py.

PODCAST_INTAKE_HOOK_SECRET.semantics: SET required — the route secret, referenced by env SecretRef, never a plaintext value. A real registration refuses when NOT SET (fail closed).

PODCAST_AGENT_ID.semantics: SET required — the podcast department agent id bound to hooks.allowedAgentIds (default dept-podcast, never main).

PODCAST_CLIENT_SLUG.semantics: SET required for a per-client route — rides the session key podcast:intake:<client-slug>.

KIE_API_KEY.semantics: SET required — cover image generation (Kie.ai, sanctioned provider). NOT SET fails the Step 0 credential gate.

FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY.semantics: SET required — episode audio synthesis (Fish Audio). NOT SET fails the Step 0 credential gate.

FISH_AUDIO_REFERENCE_ID.semantics: SET required — the client's OWN private voice model reference_id. NOT SET fails the Step 0 credential gate.

PODCAST_ENGINE_GHL_PIT.semantics: SET required — the podcast engine's own Convert and Flow Private Integration Token (prefix pit-). MUST be checked before the generic GOHIGHLEVEL_API_KEY alias (first-hit-wins wrong-tenant 403).

PODCAST_ENGINE_GHL_LOCATION_ID.semantics: SET required — the podcast engine's Convert and Flow Location ID (CjxATjhv9Gt21qSqURIt). Must equal the webhook payload location_id.

PODBEAN_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_URL.semantics: SET in publish-proxy mode (fleet default) — the operator's n8n publish webhook URL. Not a secret. Both-or-neither with PODBEAN_PUBLISH_TOKEN.

PODBEAN_PUBLISH_TOKEN.semantics: SET in publish-proxy mode (fleet default) — operator-owned header token authorizing the n8n trigger. NOT a Podbean credential. Both-or-neither with PODBEAN_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK_URL.

PODBEAN_PODCAST_ID.semantics: SET in publish-proxy mode (fleet default) — the client's Podbean Channel ID (the client's show under BlackCEO's host account). Never a secret.

PODCAST_CLIENT_LAST_NAME.semantics: SET in publish-proxy mode (fleet default) — the roster identity tuple for the n8n good-standing gate.

PODCAST_CLIENT_EMAIL.semantics: SET in publish-proxy mode (fleet default) — the roster identity tuple for the n8n good-standing gate.

department_agent.missing_message: dept-podcast runtime dir missing (~/.openclaw/agents/dept-podcast/) — the dispatch resolver holds the task as routed_but_not_dispatched. Run install-podcast-department.sh to materialize it.

intake_hook_route.missing_message: intake route not registered — run register-podcast-hook.sh --client-slug <slug>.

scheduler.cron: podcast-smoke-<client-slug> (one daily no-deliver job; the ONLY recurring podcast cron)
scheduler.missing_message: scheduler entry missing — recreate per SOP-PODCAST-04 Section 1.

controller.runbook: scripts/podcast_step_driver.py next --job-id <id> (one bounded pass in the agent's own turn; no daemon)
controller.missing_message: step driver missing or not callable on the box — the processor cannot advance a flow. Run SOP-PODCAST-07.

required_skill_match.message: podcast task must resolve Skill 58 (podcast-production-engine) before dispatch; a skill-less podcast session is a phantom-agent risk.
